modmenu.descriptionTranslation.aftermath: Server-authoritative systems for a zombie-apocalypse survival modpack.

profession.aftermath.medic.description: Starts with 4 bread, 2 honey bottles, 3 bandages, an LRTactical AI2 first-aid kit and a CarFAK kit (2 golden apples without LRTactical). First Aid level 2.
profession.aftermath.mechanic.descriptio: Starts with a Create wrench, 6 cogwheels and 8 sticks (a stone pickaxe and 6 iron nuggets without Create). Mechanics level 1.
profession.aftermath.scavenger.descripti: Starts with a stone axe, 6 bread and 8 torches.

message.aftermath.bleeding.disabled: Bleeding and first aid are disabled on this server.
message.aftermath.bleeding.status: Bleeding severity: %1$s/%2$s. Next blood loss in about %3$s sec.
message.aftermath.bandage.not_bleeding: You are not bleeding; the bandage was not used.
message.aftermath.first_aid.medic_treate: As a medic, you fully treated the bleeding with one bandage.
trait.aftermath.iron_stomach.description: Removes the vanilla Hunger effect while this trait is active.
trait.aftermath.keen_hearing.description: Selected footsteps, weapon and zombie sounds are louder on the client.
trait.aftermath.cat_eyes.description: Maintains Night Vision while this trait is active.
trait.aftermath.thick_skinned.descriptio: Takes 20% less damage from hostile mobs.
trait.aftermath.light_eater.description: Food exhaustion from normal actions is reduced by 35%.
trait.aftermath.speed_demon.description: Movement speed +5%; vehicle-specific bonuses are planned for Stage 5.
trait.aftermath.eagle_eye.description: Accuracy hook is defined; firearm spread integration arrives in Stage 4.
trait.aftermath.quick_reload.description: Reload hook is defined; firearm integration arrives in Stage 4.
trait.aftermath.deaf.description: Mutes every game sound category except MUSIC, including ambience, UI, mobs and modded sounds.
trait.aftermath.hard_of_hearing.descript: Relevant footsteps, weapon and zombie sounds are much quieter.
trait.aftermath.short_sighted.descriptio: Distant scenery becomes foggier using the standard viewport fog event.
trait.aftermath.cowardly.description: Nearby hostile mobs cause temporary Weakness and Nausea.
trait.aftermath.illiterate.description: Cannot start reading training manuals; TV learning remains available.
trait.aftermath.asthmatic.description: Sprinting adds extra food exhaustion and causes fatigue sooner.
trait.aftermath.sleepyhead.description: The trait is registered for the future sleep/fatigue system; its gameplay effect is not wired yet.
message.aftermath.learning.illiterate: You cannot read training manuals with the Illiterate trait.
screen.aftermath.character.error.profess: This trait requires a different profession.
profession.aftermath.police_officer.desc: Starts with an M1911, 6 full 7-round .45 ACP magazines, a shield, 4 bread and 8 torches. Without TaCZ/TaCZ Magazines, the gun and magazines fall back to a bow and 42 arrows. Keen Hearing is granted.
profession.aftermath.firefighter.descrip: Starts with an iron axe, leather helmet, 4 bread and a water bucket. Fit is granted.
profession.aftermath.military.descriptio: Starts with an M16A4, 3 full 30-round 5.56×45 magazines, Shturmovik V2 body armor, 3 M67 grenades, 4 bread and an iron sword. Some gear falls back to vanilla items without its mods. Strong is granted.
profession.aftermath.cook.description: Starts with a campfire, 8 cooked steaks, 4 apple pies and an iron knife (bread and a stone axe without Farmer’s Delight). Iron Stomach is granted.
profession.aftermath.engineer.descriptio: Starts with an iron pickaxe, 16 redstone, 4 iron ingots, 2 levers and 4 redstone torches. Dextrous is granted.
profession.aftermath.homeless.descriptio: Starts with wooden axe and pickaxe, 3 bread, 2 leather and 12 sticks. Gets 10 trait points and Clumsy as a free drawback.
profession.aftermath.farmer.description: Starts with a stone hoe, 16 wheat seeds, 8 carrots, 4 bread and 2 composters. Light Eater is granted.
profession.aftermath.driver.description: Starts with a compass, map, MTS vehicle key (a boat without MTS), 4 bread and leather boots. Driving level 1; Speed Demon is granted.
screen.aftermath.character.ui.footer_hin: Choose a profession and traits, then confirm your survivor.
screen.aftermath.character.error.invalid: Could not load character data. Rejoin the world.
trait.aftermath.cook_gourmet.description: Cooking skill XP gain is increased by 25%.
trait.aftermath.driver_road_instinct.des: Driving skill XP gain is increased by 25%.
trait.aftermath.engineer_precision.descr: Mechanics skill XP gain is increased by 20%.
trait.aftermath.farmer_green_thumb.descr: Farming skill XP gain is increased by 25%.
trait.aftermath.homeless_streetwise.desc: Scavenging skill XP gain is increased by 30%.
trait.aftermath.mechanic_tinker.descript: Mechanics skill XP gain is increased by 25%.
trait.aftermath.medic_triage.description: First Aid skill XP gain is increased by 25%.
trait.aftermath.military_discipline.desc: Firearms skill XP gain is increased by 25%.
trait.aftermath.police_tactical_training: Firearms skill XP gain is increased by 20%.
trait.aftermath.scavenger_keen_eye.descr: Scavenging skill XP gain is increased by 25%.
